scope: Independent AI semantic comparison of all 554 entries1900..2453 against Korean canonical and English reference; no target edits. Not native-speaker or teacher approval.
normalRationale: Checked question operation, negative/positive polarity, meanings, number and time quantities, hints versus answer explanations, English assessed utterances and reference quotations. Outer reading questions localized while quoted passages remain English. Names are retained without independent gender assignments. Pidgin e avoids adding gender. Shared technical English and common Pidgin vocabulary alone do not mean untranslated text. Descriptive vocabulary meanings (2211 onward) accepted as meanings, not new assessed answer strings.

positiveCanonicalDifferences.reason: Target correctly uses matching capital form instead of misleading literal enlargement of lowercase shape; preserves learning objective.
Target man-made clarification avoids equating every artificial thing with counterfeit; no change to English answer authentic.

entries.reason: KO 그가 누구인지 asks identity without adulthood or proximal this. English reference added this man; target repeats that unsupported narrowing. Gender of Korean 그 is existing source, not inferred from a name.
entries.proposedPatch: Tap di words for correct order to make sentence. (Meaning: You know who e be?)

entries.reason: KO quotes a native-language meaning for six hours of work, whereas reference and target turn it into a full English quotation. Since this is an instruction-side hint rather than the assessed utterance, a native Pidgin paraphrase is clearer. Six hours preserved.
entries.proposedPatch: Think wetin naturally follow di sentence before, wey talk say di person don work for six hours.

entries.reason: The explanation explicitly identifies an English answer option. Target changes an opinion letter to the board into opinion letter to di school board; preserve exact English option, localize only explanation.
entries.proposedPatch: Di answer na an opinion letter to the board. For persuasion, opinion writing wey give reasons fit. Diary entry na personal record, no be writing to persuade school board.

sourceIssues.reason: Both canonical and reference call They plural without noting singular they. Limited grammar exercise may intend plural; this cannot establish real-world referent count.

Canonical/reference shorthand says opposite of fact (no car), then no bus, and adjacent2021 asserts causal-counterfactual equivalence. Having no car and taking bus does not logically guarantee that having a car prevents bus travel. Teaching intended conditional rewrite requires explicit hypothetical framing; target faithfully reflects source.
Source present-tense conditional-if rule is categorical; will can occur with willingness/insistence. Target faithfully preserves the beginner rule; teacher scope review needed.
Source -o verbs take -es rule is overbroad (e.g. radio). Target faithfully preserves source; exception-aware teacher wording needed.

limitations: Semantic AI review is separate from native/teacher review and source validity. Canonical itself contains English educational passages; no gender inference from isolated names or unrelated items.
